description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrCollections, which manages attribute collections for HTMLPurifier modules, including loading extensions, performing inclusions, and expanding identifiers.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrCollections
classes.description: A class that manages attribute collections for HTMLPurifier modules, supporting extension loading, inclusion merging, and identifier expansion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the attribute collections by loading module extensions, merging them, and expanding identifiers.

methods.name: performInclusions
methods.description: Performs all inclusions within an attribute collection by merging included collections recursively.

methods.name: expandIdentifiers
methods.description: Replaces string identifiers in attribute definitions with actual attribute objects, utilizing the HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes instance.
